name: Killer Whale
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules, read in a text mirror
heading: Killer Whale Traits
sourceDistinctions: Natural armor and Keen Hearing appear in the design commentary only. The printed bite deals slashing damage. Bellfin uses Unarmored Defense.

name: Lion
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules, read in a text mirror
heading: Lion Traits
sourceDistinctions: The playable Pounce uses a shove contest after a hit. The encounter lion’s fixed save, follow-up bite, and other stat-block rules are separate.

name: Mastiff
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules, read in a text mirror
heading: Mastiff Traits
sourceDistinctions: The player bite lacks the encounter mastiff’s prone rider. The primary bite keeps its racial die. Kamstra’s p. 7 rule gives the martial-arts and Flurry bonus strikes the ordinary monk die and bludgeoning damage.

name: Mule
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules, read in a text mirror
heading: Mule Traits
sourceDistinctions: Sure-footed protects against being knocked prone, using the checks and saves named in the player text. The hide armor is fitted barding, not a racial AC bonus.

name: Octopus
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored rules, read in a text mirror
heading: Octopus Traits
sourceDistinctions: Medium size is from the player trait block. The design notes discuss Small size and Grab, neither granted by the player traits.
The player entry leaves the cost of releasing ink unspecified. Knots uses an action, matching the 2014 encounter octopus. The player’s 20-ft. radius and 1-minute maximum duration still apply.
The player’s tentacle explicitly qualifies as finesse for Sneak Attack, and its grip may operate most nonweapon objects.
